**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: LGTM mode

## Walkthrough The FRRConfiguration CRD updates router and neighbor ASNs to `int64` and adds an eBGP-only `localASN` neighbor field with validation bounds. ### Changes **FRR BGP ASN schema** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Update BGP ASN and local ASN schema**
`bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml`|Router and neighbor `asn` fields use `int64`, and BGP neighbors gain an eBGP-only `localASN` field constrained from 1 through 4294967295.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Suggested reviewers:** `mattedallo`, `taanyas` --- > [!CAUTION] > ## Pre-merge checks failed > > Please resolve all errors before merging. Addressing warnings is optional. > > - [ ] Ignore ### ❌ Failed checks (3 errors, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :-----------------------: | :------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Pr Quality | ❌ Error | GitHub shows “No description provided”; this non-trivial CRD schema change lacks the required Why/What/Testing sections. | Add a PR body with Why, What, and automated CI Testing/verification (jobs/platforms), plus user impact/rollback notes if applicable. | | Commit Message Quality | ❌ Error | The only commit has a one-line subject and no explanatory body; its body is just a sign-off, not the rationale required. | Rewrite the commit as `frr-k8s: Align CRD schema with 5.0` and add a body explaining why the ASN/localASN schema changes are needed. | | Unit Tests For Go Changes | ❌ Error | bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml changed, but no *_test.go files were added or modified. | Add or update tests for the CRD change, or document why existing tests/triviality make new tests unnecessary in the PR description's "How to verify it". | | Description check | ❓ Inconclusive | No pull request description was provided, so the intent is too vague to assess meaningfully. | Add a short description explaining the CRD schema updates and the new localASN field. |
✅ Passed checks (20 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | E2e Tests For Feature Changes | ✅ Passed | Only bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml changed; no pkg/cmd Go files or test/e2e files were modified, so the E2E check is not applicable. | | Rbac Least Privilege | ✅ Passed | Only bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml changed, and it updates FRRConfiguration schema; no ClusterRole/Role rules or verbs/resources were modified. | | Docs For Feature And Behavior Changes | ✅ Passed | PASS: The PR only updates the vendored frr-k8s CRD schema in bindata; no docs/ files changed, and this is an upstream CRD alignment. | | Stale Project Docs And Config | ✅ Passed | No project docs/config mention FRRConfiguration or localASN; the only BGP note in .coderabbit.yaml still matches the current schema. | | Go And Test Code Quality | ✅ Passed | Only bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml changed; no Go or test code was modified, so none of the Go/Test code-quality checks apply. | | Ai-Generated Code Smell | ✅ Passed | Only schema fields were updated; no AI references, filler comments, redundant code, or unrelated test blocks were added. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | The commit only updates a CRD YAML; no test files or Ginkgo titles were added or modified. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | Only bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml changed; no Ginkgo test code was modified, so this test-quality check is not applicable. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only the FRRConfiguration CRD YAML changed; no It/Describe/Context Ginkgo tests were added, so MicroShift compatibility is unaffected. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only a CRD YAML changed; no new Ginkgo tests or multi-node assumptions were introduced. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only the frr-k8s CRD schema changed; no manifests, controllers, or scheduling/topology constraints were added. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR only changes a CRD YAML; no main/init/TestMain/suite setup or logging code was touched, so stdout contract risk is absent. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only bindata/network/frr-k8s/001-crd.yaml changed; no Ginkgo tests or network-bearing test code were added. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | The PR only updates a CRD YAML schema/docs; scans found no MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/ECB, custom crypto, or secret-comparison logic. | | Container-Privileges | ✅ Passed | PASS: The only changed file is a CRD schema; the diff adds int64 ASN/localASN fields and contains no privileged/hostPID/hostNetwork/allowPrivilegeEscalation settings. | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ✅ Passed | Only CRD schema/docs changed; no logging statements or sensitive-data emissions were added. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title is concise, imperative, and accurately summarizes the CRD alignment changes. |
